title: Croatian Sausage Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful skillet dish inspired by Croatian cuisine, featuring warm, yeasty sausage and a variety of spices.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of oil to the skillet and swirl it around.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, until softened.
Add the chopped bell pepper to the skillet and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the Croatian sausages to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes, until browned.
Season the sausage with salt, black pepper, and chili flakes to taste.
Serve the sausage and vegetables hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
